description: Start a user-registered project with its registered command, in its registered path. Neither can be changed. PREFER this over run_process: call list_projects first, and if a project is registered inside the checkout you are working in, start it here instead of running the command yourself. Do NOT use this from a git worktree for a project registered in the main checkout: it would start the main checkout, not your worktree. Use get_project, then run_process with the worktree path.
name: start_project
title: Start a registered project
